title: 第21章 走出泰坦之谷第22章 遇到火狐人
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
踏出力量神殿的洞口，步入眼帘的是一个山谷，虽然依然空旷，但相对于之前的环境，要显得好了一些。今日，也是孙云决定，走出泰坦之谷的日子，出于对外界的好奇，大家都兴奋不已。
因为对外界的未知，所以孙云没有带大部队，只挑选了一些精英。毕竟，几十万蚁族物资消耗太大，也太过惹眼，不太适合赶路。
所以，经过众位军团长的商议，让黑头和红头留下，继续发展蚁军。其它每个军团长，各带四位战士，组成这次的冒险小队。
当然，孙云这样安排，是有原因的。因为，只有黑头能服众，也比较顾全大局。红头又贪图享受，但是有最头脑的，辅佐黑头是最合适不过了。虽然红头比较滑头，但却知道什么该做什么不该做，就像奸臣和绅。
（和绅在古装戏里一直是个贪官，但在孙云心里可不这么认为，反而觉得和绅是个皇帝非常喜爱的一个人物。和绅的作用，还真不比刘罗锅和季小岚小，贪官是每朝每代都必不可少的人物。
比如说抗洪救灾，和大人把皇帝给的粮食，换成了糠面发给灾民。虽然和珅背负了骂名，但确实变相的完成了任务，救活了许多百姓。
有人会说，可以直接用粮食啊，糠面怎么吃啊，喂猪都不愿意吃。可是震灾的粮食毕竟有限，救不了多少人，如果只吃一两天，还不是一样得饿死。
糠不能吃，总比树叶、树皮、草根甚至人肉好吧！又有人说贪官贪的，够救很多人了。可是让你饿着肚子去给灾民分粮食你会去么？每个人都是自私的，都有妻儿老小，没有人照顾不好自己家人，而跑去帮助别人。
不喂饱一些人，怎么能有人给你卖命，制止更多的人因为饥饿产生的暴乱呢？所以和绅一直得皇上器重的手下，有些不方便说，不方便做的，和大人都默契的帮皇上解决了。
当然，大奸大恶之人，当然也要有人压制，刘罗锅和季小岚的威望跟执着，当然是最好的选择。所以，无法定义绝对的好坏人，每个人都他的定位和作用。）
冒险小队，都挑的四阶以上的战士，为了组成这个战队，孙云投资了很多的魔兽晶核。除了牛犬蚁没有进化的迹象，其它的都进化成了半人蚁，经过这段时间的操练，也有模有样的了。
冒险队前锋疯战和五位战士，擅长近战，武器是孙云精心打造的弯刀。虽然，孙云技术一般，但重点是泰坦矮人留的材料好。
重力步兵和牛犬蚁改成了骑兵，武器改成了狼牙棒，综合战力绝对不低。相比与重木，狼牙棒更方便挥舞，也分量够重，使用起来自然更加顺手。
牛犬蚁智力不高，虽然不愿意当坐骑，但也由不得它们。被明显等级高的重力步兵蚁，用狼牙棒揍了一顿，又给了颗魔兽晶核，就屁颠屁颠的认命了。重兵蚁和牛犬蚁的合并，使他们的战力大增，相信只要经过一段时间的磨合，绝对不止一加一等于二那么简单。
行军蚁的战斗力，相对于其它战士较弱，但重在纪律严明，暂时负责垫后工作。每个战士也配上了一对双斧，蚂蚁天生神力，在他们手里被舞的虎虎生风，到也有模有样。
飞行蚁，孙云本来打算给他们打造长枪，但技术不行，打造不出枪的韧性。只能让每个战士背了一些仓库机关的箭，又能当武器，又可以当飞枪。
侦察兵由小奇带领，选了四位雷霆成员，都是的灵巧型的战士。除了标配的战斧，还都配备的锋利的短刀，方便侦查和自保。
近卫队，由啊泰与原雷霆负团长啊水为主，他俩实力都不错，而且战斗经验丰富。俩蛇要么就乱跑，要么就是在睡觉，丝毫不在意主人的感受。
还有一个红头推荐的小黑，天赋是吐毒刺，到也是个偷袭的好技能。孙云给了他一个传令兵的名头，毕竟的给红头面子，多少得要他一个兵呀。
至于彩翼鸟，自然给孙云当了坐骑，现在也突破到了四阶实力。而身为老大的孙云，资源和智力方面都有优势，已经突破到了五阶，算是最接近人类的一个了。

孙云带着二十八个战士和两条蛇，组成的游历小队，就这么出发了。

昆泰大陆，迎来了新的纪元，偏居于大陆东北的兽人山脉，居住着落魄的兽人族。兽人被称为野蛮民族，因物资缺乏，又不善生产，其族群性格暴躁顽劣，相互之间也互相征战。
兽人与相邻的北约王国，常年发生冲突，但往往败多胜少。毕竟，北约王国的军队更加正轨，土兵执行力更强，而且还有远超兽人的士兵数量。而兽人这边，大多都是招募的民兵，组织纪律性不强，大多依靠彪悍的民风。
北约国王泰落，身高一米八二，是一位五十多岁的人类国王。十六参军做战勇猛，二十五岁的的时候带领人族军队，消灭掉了北约北部的兽人部落，把兽人逼迫到荒原。仅仅坐皇帝不到三十年，就把北约王国一手建立成强大的帝国。他是个富有传奇色彩的人类国王，他的子民都非常爱戴他。
在昆泰大陆，除了相邻兽人山脉的北约王国，也建立了几个其它王国。西北部的雪山王国，终年积雪，地域寒冷，相邻冰雪之岭。东南部的林脉王国，种族杂乱，山匪居多，相邻原始森林。西南部的南海王国，土地肥沃，海产丰富，相邻茫然大海。
四大王国的人族，把其它种族四分五裂在各处，占领昆泰大陆比较肥沃的土地。虽然四国地域分明，但因其之间也有矛盾，战争也连连发生，使得民不聊生。
所以四国经过商议，在四国之间建立了自由之城，由各国的强者维持。全城人口达百余万之多，人类、兽人、精灵、矮人族、强盗、山贼这些都可以在城内见到。
城内唯一的规定是不准打斗，打斗可以去角斗场或出城。繁华的自由之城，也渐渐成为了商人的聚集地，此处任何东西都可以买卖。
content_en:
Stepping out of the entrance of the Temple of Power, you will see a valley. Although it is still empty, it looks better than the previous environment. Today was also the day Sun Yun decided to leave the Valley of Titans. Out of curiosity about the outside world, everyone was very excited.
Because he was unknown to the outside world, Sun Yun did not lead a large army, but only selected some elites. After all, hundreds of thousands of ants consume too much supplies and are too eye-catching to be suitable for traveling.
Therefore, after discussion among the army leaders, the black heads and red heads were allowed to stay and continue to develop the ant army. Each of the other legion commanders will lead four warriors to form this adventure team.
Of course, there is a reason why Sun Yun arranged it this way. Because only Blackhead can convince the public and is more considerate of the overall situation. Red heads are greedy for enjoyment, but they have the most brains, so it is best to assist black heads. Although the red head is more cunning, he knows what to do and what not to do, just like the traitor and the gentry.
(He Shen has always been a corrupt official in costume dramas, but Sun Yun did not think so in his heart. Instead, he felt that He Shen was a character that the emperor loved very much. He Shen's role is really no smaller than that of Liu Luoguo and Ji Xiaolan. Corrupt officials are indispensable figures in every dynasty and every generation.
For example, during flood relief, Mr. He exchanged the grain given by the emperor for bran flour and distributed it to the victims. Although He Shen suffered from infamy, he did complete the task in disguise and saved many people.
Some people will say that you can use grain directly. How can you eat bran noodles? They don’t even want to feed pigs. However, the food provided by the earthquake was limited after all, and not many people could be saved. If they only ate for a day or two, they would still starve to death.
The bran is inedible, but it’s better than leaves, bark, grass roots or even human flesh! Some people say that corrupt officials are enough to save many people. But if you are asked to go hungry to distribute food to the victims, will you go? Everyone is selfish and has a wife, children, and children. No one can't take care of his own family and runs to help others.
If you don't feed some people, how can someone work for you and stop more people from rioting because of hunger? Therefore, He Shen, who has always been respected by the emperor, had some inconvenient things to say and do, so he and his Excellency had a tacit understanding to help the emperor solve them.
Of course, the most evil people must be suppressed by someone. The prestige and persistence of Liu Luoguo and Ji Xiaolan are of course the best choice. Therefore, it is impossible to define absolute good and bad people, everyone has his own position and role. )
The adventure team all selected warriors of level 4 or above. In order to form this team, Sun Yun invested a lot of Warcraft crystal cores. Except for the bulldog ants, which showed no signs of evolution, the others all evolved into half-human ants. After this period of training, they have become somewhat impressive.
The adventure team's vanguard, Kuang Zhan, and five warriors were good at close combat, and their weapons were scimitars carefully crafted by Sun Yun. Although Sun Yun's skills are average, the key point is that the materials left by the Titan dwarves are good.
The gravity infantry and bulldog ants have been changed to cavalry, and the weapons have been changed to maces. The overall combat power is definitely not low. Compared with heavy wood, maces are easier to swing and are heavy enough, making them easier to use.
Bulldog ants are not very intelligent. Although they are unwilling to be mounts, they cannot be controlled by them. He was beaten with a mace by an obviously high-level gravity infantry ant, and given a Warcraft crystal core, he resigned to his fate. The merger of the Heavy Soldier Ants and the Bulldog Ants has greatly increased their combat power. I believe that after a period of running-in, it will definitely be more than just one plus one equals two.
The combat effectiveness of the army ants is weaker than that of other warriors, but their emphasis is on strict discipline and they are temporarily responsible for the rearguard work. Each warrior is also equipped with a pair of double axes. The ants are born with magical power, and they are danced like tigers and tigers in their hands, which is also impressive.
Sun Yun originally planned to build spears for flying ants, but his technology was not good enough and he could not create the toughness of the spear. We can only let each soldier carry some arrows from the warehouse mechanism, which can be used as weapons andFlying gun.
The scouts were led by Xiaoqi and selected four members of Thunder, all of whom were dexterous warriors. In addition to the standard tomahawk, they are also equipped with sharp daggers to facilitate detection and self-protection.
The Guards are mainly composed of Ah Tai and Ah Shui, the former leader of the Thunder Group. Both of them have good strength and rich combat experience. The two snakes were either running around or sleeping, not caring about their owner's feelings.
There is also Xiao Hei recommended by a red head. His talent is to spit poisonous stings, and he is also a good skill for sneak attacks. Sun Yun gave him the title of a messenger. After all, to give the red head face, he would have to be a soldier.
As for the colorful winged bird, it naturally became a mount for Sun Yun, and now it has broken through to the fourth level of strength. As the boss, Sun Yun has advantages in resources and intelligence. He has broken through to the fifth level and is considered the closest to human beings.
Sun Yun set off with a traveling team composed of twenty-eight warriors and two snakes.

The continent of Quintai has ushered in a new era. The Orc Mountains located in the northeast of the continent are home to the down-and-out Orc tribe. The orcs are called a barbaric people. Due to the lack of materials and poor production, their tribe has a violent and stubborn character, and they also fight against each other.
The orcs have been in conflict with the neighboring NATO kingdoms all year round, but they often lose more than they win. After all, the NATO kingdom's army is more on track, the soldiers have stronger execution capabilities, and they have far more soldiers than the orcs. As for the orcs, most of them are recruited militiamen. Their organizational discipline is not strong, and most of them rely on tough folk customs.
The King of NATO, Tailuo, is 1.82 meters tall and is a human king in his fifties. Sixteen joined the army and fought bravely. When he was twenty-five years old, he led the human army and wiped out the orc tribes in the northern part of the North Atlantic Ocean, forcing the orcs into the wilderness. In less than thirty years as emperor, he single-handedly built the NATO Kingdom into a powerful empire. He is a legendary human king, and his people love him very much.
In the Quintai continent, in addition to the Nato Kingdom adjacent to the Orc Mountains, several other kingdoms have also been established. The Snow Mountain Kingdom in the northwest is covered with snow all year round, the area is cold, and it is adjacent to the Ice and Snow Ridge. The forest kingdom in the southeast is a mixed race, mostly bandits, and is adjacent to a primeval forest. The Nanhai Kingdom in the southwest has fertile land, rich seafood, and is adjacent to the vast sea.
The human races of the four kingdoms scattered other races everywhere and occupied the relatively fertile land of Quintai Continent. Although the four countries are geographically distinct, there are conflicts among them and wars occur one after another, making the people's lives miserable.
Therefore, the four countries negotiated and established a free city between the four countries, which was maintained by the strong men of each country. The city has a population of over one million, and humans, orcs, elves, dwarves, bandits, and bandits can all be found in the city.
The only rule in the city is that no fighting is allowed. You can fight in the arena or outside the city. The prosperous Free City has gradually become a gathering place for merchants, where anything can be bought and sold.
